turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.CRITICAL.justification: Both fields represent the count of critical severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MAJOR.justification: Major severity breakdowns can be conceptually related to high severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MINOR.justification: Minor severity breakdowns can be related to low severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.NORMAL.justification: Normal severity breakdowns can be conceptually related to medium severity vulnerabilities.
